tools.name: list_applicants
tools.title: List applicants
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of applicants with filtering capabilities. Defaults to only YOUR applicants (those assigned to you or unassigned in openings you own) — pass scope: "all" to return all applicants you have access to. The default scope applies only to an unscoped list; any funnel/stage/query/applicant_ids filter targets a specific set and is never narrowed to yours. Supports filtering by multiple openings and stages. When booking_status is provided with scheduler stage filters, the uav_url includes a pre-built scheduling filter. Returns a paginated list of applicants and the total count. Each applicant's stage includes title and short_type — always refer to a stage by one of those; type is an internal class name and must never be shown to the user (e.g. HiredStage is "Approved", ArchivedStage is "On Hold").

funnel_id.description: External_id of a single opening to scope the search to. Never fabricate this from an opening's name, location, or title — resolve it first: call list_funnels with a query matching what the user said, e.g. list_funnels(query: "Store Associate - Downtown"), then read external_id off the matching result and pass it here. Mutually exclusive with funnel_ids — the request should carry one or the other not both.

funnel_ids.description: External_ids of multiple openings to scope the search to. Resolve each one via list_funnels first — do not guess ids from opening names. Use when filtering across a known set. Mutually exclusive with funnel_id; if both arrive funnel_ids wins.

stage_id.description: External_id of a single stage. Discover via get_opening_details or pipeline_summary. Combine with funnel_id to drill into one stage of one opening; combine with funnel_ids to find applicants on a stage with this external_id across multiple openings. Mutually exclusive with stage_ids.

stage_ids.description: External_ids of multiple stages. Discover via get_opening_details or pipeline_summary. Mutually exclusive with stage_id. When booking_status is also set these stages should be SchedulerStage stages for the booking filter to be meaningful.

query.description: Free-text search across applicant name, email, phone, and configured custom data fields only — it does NOT match opening/funnel names, titles, or locations. To filter by opening, resolve a funnel_id via list_funnels instead and pass that. Sanitised server-side. Combine freely with any filter above.

page.description: 1-indexed page number. Iterate by comparing pagination.total_pages on the response.

per_page.description: Page size — must be one of 10 / 20 / 50 / 100. Validated server-side; out-of-range values return a 400.

booking_status.description: Scheduler-stage booking states to keep — one or more of not_scheduled / scheduled / missing_attendance / attended / not_attended / cancelled. Most useful when paired with a SchedulerStage stage_id or stage_ids. When set the returned uav_url is augmented with a scheduling filter so the user can drill into the same view.

applicant_ids.description: Curated list of applicant external_ids — typically supplied by an upstream agent such as Optimize to render a known set. The user's access ACL is still applied; ids the user cannot see drop out silently. Never use as a security boundary.

scope.description: Whose applicants to return. "mine" — the default — returns only YOUR applicants: those assigned to you plus unassigned applicants in openings you own. "all" returns every applicant in the account you have access to. Use "all" ONLY when the request explicitly reaches beyond you — e.g. the whole account / everyone's / all recruiters / company-wide. A bare all or todas is not sufficient on its own. When unsure use "mine". Ignored when any funnel/stage/query/applicant_ids filter is present — those already target a specific set.

success.description: Discriminator — narrow on this when handling the response

external_id.description: Stable applicant external_id — use for every downstream applicant tool call

name.description: Applicant display name — first plus last

phone_number.description: Primary phone in E.164 format; null when unavailable

external_id.description: Stable opening external_id — pass to funnel-scoped tools

title.description: Human-readable opening title as shown in the recruiter UI

funnel.description: Opening the applicant is currently in

external_id.description: Stable stage external_id — pass to stage-scoped tools

title.description: Stage title as configured by the recruiter — always call the stage by this name when talking to the user

type.description: Internal STI class name — never show this to the user; use title or short_type instead

short_type.description: Humanized stage kind — e.g. HiredStage shows as Approved; ArchivedStage shows as On Hold. Safe fallback name when title is generic

profile_url.description: Direct deep link to the applicant drawer scoped to their current stage — render this when surfacing applicants to a recruiter
